brand_dna.category: Reusable leakproof period underwear - eco-friendly, non-toxic menstrual wellness for women.
brand_dna.core_belief: Menstrual care is not a luxury, it is a right - period care should feel safe, soft, and sacred rather than clinical.
proof_points: Triple-layered leakproof lining absorbing 3-5 tampons worth of flow
Up to 12 hours of protection; one pair replaces hundreds of disposables
brand_dna.positioning: Premium, values-led alternative to conventional disposables - soft and beautiful, never medical or clinical.

icp: Eco-conscious women who want safe, non-toxic, reusable period protection and see caring for their cycle as an act of self-respect and sustainability.

personas.name: The Clean-Ingredient Seeker
personas.description: Reads labels and worries about plastics and chemicals near her body - moved by PFAS-free, OEKO-TEX, and non-toxic messaging.

personas.name: The Waste-Conscious Switcher
personas.description: Tired of monthly disposables and their footprint - moved by 'one pair replaces hundreds' and reusable, planet-first framing.

personas.name: The Cycle-Aligned Woman
personas.description: Sees her period as natural and sacred, not a problem to hide - moved by empowering, cyclical, self-care language.

allowed.claim: PFAS-free underwear tested for known hazardous substances
Triple-layered leakproof lining absorbs 3-5 tampons worth of flow
One pair replaces hundreds of disposable products

banned.claim: Prevents or treats infections, rashes, or vaginal conditions
banned.why: Disease claim - product cannot claim to treat, cure, or prevent a condition.

banned.claim: Cures or relieves period pain, cramps, or PMS
banned.why: Disease claim - implies treatment of a medical condition.

banned.claim: Clinically proven leakproof or clinically proven non-toxic
banned.why: No cited study provided - 'clinically proven' is banned without a citation.

banned.claim: Guaranteed zero leaks for everyone, every time
banned.why: Guaranteed-results claim - absorption is stated as up to a limit, not guaranteed.
Unqualified/absolute safety claim not supported; site states PFAS-free and 90% eco-friendly, not chemical-free.

banned.claim: Balances hormones or detoxes the body
banned.why: Disease/structure-function overreach not supported by any evidence on the site.
